scope: Native function_exported_3 against the Isolate-owned published export namespace, including admitted native and instruction exports.
adaptations: Require atom module/function and a small-integer arity; preserve native badarg for other types. Native C-int narrowing is expressed as defined uint32_t conversion: small arities 4294967297 and -4294967295 query arity 1, independently confirmed on installed OTP.

Charge one boundary step and each visited export. The actual published namespace includes available guest exports, native BIFs, and the apply/3 instruction export. Private/nonexistent exports and absent modules return false without autoloading, atom interning, code leases, payload traversal, allocation or collection.

Queries describe this runtime's actual available exports, not a fabricated complete OTP builtin catalog. Unadmitted capabilities are not reported as available. The fixed namespace remains owned by the code space throughout execution.

Compiler fixtures and an independent OTP oracle cover loaded/native/instruction hits, private/missing misses, arity wrapping and badarg. Native tests enumerate work prefixes for all cases, deny allocator and quota at the real BIF boundary, preserve source/heap/namespace identity and code-user counts, and distinguish two live Worlds' export scopes. Shared-worker byte/budget/reuse/peer/reclamation tests use the compiled copy wrapper.
